test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that contains a grammatical error in the underlined portion.**

Not the word was said during the general discussion about the concerns regarding these people

options.text: Not the word was said during the general discussion about the concerns __regarding these people.__
Not the word was said __during the general discussion __about the concerns regarding these people.
__Not the word was said__ during the general discussion about the concerns regarding these people.
Not the word was said during the general discussion __about the concerns__ regarding these people.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**Not the word was said during the general discussion about the concerns regarding these people.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence has a grammatical error in the word placement: "**Not the word was said**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**Not a word was said**," ensuring the sentence maintains proper syntax.
 
• The phrase "**Not a word**" accurately conveys silence or absence of speech during the discussion.
 
• Correcting the sentence structure improves readability and grammatical correctness.

Therefore, **option 3** is the correct answer
